trades.title: Trades
trades.emptyState: No trades yet. Click "Add Trade" to log your first trade.

columnTooltips.date: The date when the trade was placed or position was opened
columnTooltips.time: The time when the trade was placed or position was opened
columnTooltips.ticker: The trading symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH
columnTooltips.avgEntry: Entry price for a single entry, or average entry price across partial entries
columnTooltips.stopLoss: The price level where your stop loss was set
columnTooltips.avgExit: Final average price at which you exited the trade (win or loss)
columnTooltips.risk: Risk in USD$ including slippage and fees
columnTooltips.realisedLoss: Your PnL in USD$ if the trade was a loss
columnTooltips.realisedWin: Your PnL in USD$ if the trade was a win
columnTooltips.deviation: How much your Realised Loss exceeded your Risk due to slippage. 0% means you lost exactly your risk amount. e.g. Risk $10, Realised Loss $15 = 50% deviation
columnTooltips.rMultiple: Profit or loss in R multiples. Max possible loss should be 1R
columnTooltips.cumulativePnl: Total profit or loss in USD$ up to this trade
columnTooltips.cumulativeR: Total profit or loss in R multiples up to this trade
columnTooltips.rulesFollowed: Did you follow the rules exactly? If NO, the challenge is considered failed
columnTooltips.setupType: Strategy category, e.g. Trend Following, Pullback

deleteColumnDialog.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
deleteColumnDialog.description: This will permanently remove the column and all its settings. This action cannot be undone.
deleteColumnDialog.hint: Consider hiding the column instead — you can always show it again later.

patches.deleteConfirmDescription: This will permanently delete the patch and all its trades. This action cannot be undone.

patches.allHiddenBody: Unhide a patch from the menu below, or create a new one.
